summary.plain: A flat river-valley site in Siberia, near the village of Oktyomtsy about 50 km from Yakutsk, covered by a network of particle detectors that catches giant cosmic-ray air showers.
summary.technical: Yakutsk extensive air shower array in the Lena river valley near Oktyomtsy (61.70 N, 129.40 E, 100 m a.s.l., 1020 g/cm2); detector area has varied between about 5.6 and 17 km2.
